C09-M02-L02-F1.title: What a write blocker forwards, stops and relays
C09-M02-L02-F1.caption: A read and an identification query pass through unaltered; a modifying command stops at the blocker.
C09-M02-L02-F1.alt: Sequence diagram with three lanes: examiner host, hardware write blocker and evidence drive. The host sends a read of a sector range; the blocker forwards it; the drive returns sector data; the blocker returns the same data unaltered. The host then sends a write, trim or erase command; the blocker does not forward it and replies to the host with a refusal whose form varies by product. Finally the host sends an identify and capacity query; the blocker forwards it; the drive returns model, serial and reported capacity; the blocker relays them unaltered.
C09-M02-L02-F1.note: The modifying command never reaches the evidence drive; reads and identity pass through unchanged.

C09-M02-L02-F2.title: The boundary of "write-blocked"
C09-M02-L02-F2.caption: What a source write blocker controls, set against acquisition risks that need other records.
C09-M02-L02-F2.alt: Comparison with two columns separated by vs. Left, green, Controlled by the blocker: host write commands to the source; trim, deallocate and erase commands; firmware download and configuration changes; operating-system mounting and housekeeping writes; relaying identity and read data intact. Right, orange, Outside its control: SSD controller background maintenance; unstable reads from failing media; capacity not reported by the device; writes to the destination drive; changes before the blocker was attached; live memory, network shares and cloud sources.

C09-M02-L02-F2.note: "Write-blocked" answers one question about the source; record the others separately.

C09-M02-L02-F3.title: Acquisition-day routine for a write blocker
C09-M02-L02-F3.caption: Prove the unit, set the mode, then connect the evidence, leaving a record at every step.
C09-M02-L02-F3.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of seven steps: check the tool register for serial, firmware and last pre-use check; pre-use check on reference media with hash before, connection as in casework and hash after; set and record read-only mode before the evidence drive is connected; connect evidence through the blocker noting power-on time; record pass-through identity of model, serial and reported capacity; acquire and hash, verifying the image against the stream hash; complete the receipt and custody entry, including anything that went wrong.
